## Requirements

Use Linux or macOS, Python 3.13 or newer, and a running Docker-compatible engine with Docker Compose v2.

The Python package provides the launcher and CLI. `shinbot start` runs the application services in Docker.

## Install the release

[Install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) if you do not have it, then run:

```sh
uv tool install --prerelease allow shinbot
shinbot start
```

To install a specific release, use `uv tool install shinbot==VERSION` with the version from the [release page](https://github.com/adarshdigievo/shinbot/releases).

For a one-command launch with uv already installed:

```sh
uvx --prerelease allow --from shinbot shinbot start
```

You can also use pip inside a virtual environment:

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --pre shinbot
shinbot start
```

The first start pulls the versioned service images from `adarshd96/shinbot`. Published images support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`. The launcher generates private service credentials and opens `http://localhost:8765` with a setup link.

## Build from source

```sh
git clone https://github.com/adarshdigievo/shinbot.git
cd shinbot
uv run --frozen shinbot start --build
```

Use the source path when developing ShinBot. It builds the same services from `deploy/Dockerfile` instead of relying on published images.

## Headless or remote host

Start without opening a browser:

```sh
shinbot start --no-open-browser
shinbot setup-token
```

Connect through an [SSH tunnel](31-remote-access.qmd), open Home, and paste the installation token. Treat the token as a temporary installation credential. Do not share it or include it in screenshots.

## Stop and check the services

```sh
shinbot status
shinbot doctor
shinbot stop
```

`stop` keeps your data. The services restart after a Docker engine restart, subject to the engine starting at boot. On a laptop, jobs cannot run while the host or its container VM is asleep.

Continue with [first-time setup](02-first-steps.qmd).
